title: An op judged against parts beside its source does not read Stale when one of them moves

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
**What happens:** since #1603 (stock-source pocket family), #1607 (every stock-source 2D kind with a part law) and #1621 (a part-source op against the setup's other parts, PR #1622), an operation's verdict is read against parts BESIDE its source (`keep_law::parts_in_stock`, `keep_law::neighbour_parts`). The op's stamp (`operation::stamp::current_stamp`) still digests only the source (plus the stock for a non-stock source). So after a clean generation, a part that is moved into the cut, added, un-tagged as a fixture, or un-marked as raw stock only leaves the op `Ok` with a verdict nobody gave.

- Aligned stock: the program sim judges every part live at post and refuses.
- **Turned stock** (the sim refuses to judge): the post reads the ops' cached verdicts - all `Ok` and clean - and the program goes out into the moved part. Same hole the original #1603 / #1607 / #1621 fixes closed, re-opened by an edit after generation.

The other direction is fail-safe but confusing: marking a casting raw stock only (#1094) or moving a neighbour away leaves the op `Ok` with its old gouges cached; the post refuses until the user regenerates for no visible reason.

**Tried on PR #1622 and pulled back** (branch `issue/1607-stock-source-law`: f4d86b41 and 6abccc77 add it, the commit after dae97790 takes it out again): a stamp term digesting the kept set (`name`, `setup_align::pose_in`, `model::geometry_signature` of each model the part laws read; written only when the set is non-empty). It works (pinned: moving the neighbour makes the op Stale; red without the term), but it breaks established stamp contracts that need a maintainer's call:
- `fixtures.rs::workholding_never_stales_a_fresh_toolpath` - un-tagging a vise turns it into a part, so the op goes Stale (the "workholding never stales" law, M2.3).
- `operations.rs::a_frommodel_stock_survives_its_source_being_deleted` and `a_model_update_does_not_touch_a_box_stock` - "a stock-based path never reads the model": a stock-source Face now does (its parts).
- `fidelity_copies.rs` (2 tests) - deleting the stock's coarse source model makes the stock-source op Stale, so the gate says "regenerate" instead of the named fidelity refusal.
- `stock_source_verdict.rs` - marking the casting raw stock only stales a part-source op.

**Options:** (a) the stamp term above, restating those contracts (the kept parts are inputs; workholding stays out only while it is tagged); (b) no stamp term, but the post re-reads the part laws live for ops whose kept set changed (like the workholding gate does), so nothing churns; (c) (b) only when the sim cannot judge.

Found while fixing #1621 (PR #1622; `docs/decisions/1607-stock-source-law.md`).

Done means: a part moved into a stock-source or part-source op's cut after generation never posts on a turned stock (refused by name, Stale or live re-judgement); the chosen option's contract changes are decided and recorded; pinned and mutation-checked.
